items.detail: The 14 generated case_checklist_v1 files are validated drafts, not reviewed and locked contract/v1 files. Planning intentionally uses an isolated empty contracts directory and deterministic fallback contracts with required_artifacts=[]. Results cannot enter formal scoring until the review/lock lifecycle is completed and provenance is reconciled.

The outer case scheduler is capped at two concurrent jobs as requested, while each unchanged experimental agent config declares rate_limit.concurrent_requests=1. Tau2 remains max-concurrency=1 inside each case. The unchanged agents config hash is preserved; observed peak concurrency will be audited.

The checked-in tau3 adapter contains literal <UV_BINARY> and a non-namespaced remote output path. Only the isolated controller copy was patched to read benchmark.uv_binary and use remote_job_result_dir; the working repository source was not overwritten.

The original remaining-14 manifest remains untouched. A namespaced prelock run amendment binds the deployed Vultr infra file while preserving source bundle, agent config, selection, case order and record slots.

The first dependency setup command invoked uv sync from /root and failed because pyproject.toml was absent there. It was immediately rerun from the pinned Tau2 checkout and succeeded. No benchmark job had started.
